product.name: Monoprice Cat6 Ethernet Patch Cable - Snagless RJ45 Stranded 550MHz UTP Pure Bare Copper Wire 24AWG 5ft Red
product.description: The Monoprice Cat6 Patch Cable is a high‑quality Ethernet cable designed to provide reliable and fast network connections. With its impressive features and superior construction, this cable is a must‑have for anyone seeking seamless connectivity.Featuring an Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP) Category 6 design, this Ethernet cable ensures optimal performance for both home and professional networking applications. Its 24AWG stranded, pure bare copper conductors deliver enhanced conductivity and signal integrity, allowing for high‑speed data transmission without any loss or interference.Equipped with 50µm gold plated contacts, this cable guarantees excellent corrosion resistance and superior signal conductivity. These contacts ensure a secure and stable connection, enabling you to enjoy uninterrupted network performance.With a bandwidth of 550MHz, this Cat6 cable offers ample capacity for handling bandwidth‑intensive tasks such as streaming HD videos, online gaming, and large file transfers. You can rely on this cable to deliver high‑speed and reliable data transmission, even in demanding network environments.One of the standout features of this Ethernet cable is its snagless cable boot. The snagless design protects the plug retaining clip from damage during installation or removal, ensuring durability and longevity. You can confidently connect and disconnect this cable without worrying about accidental damage or interruptions.The full‑boot connectors of the Monoprice Cat6 Patch Cable provide added strain relief and protect the cable from bending or twisting. This feature enhances the cable's durability and prevents premature wear and tear, making it a reliable choice for long‑lasting performance.In addition to its outstanding performance, this Ethernet cable prioritizes safety and compliance with industry standards. Unlike cables that use copper clad aluminum (CCA) wire, the Monoprice Cat6 Patch Cable is constructed using 100% pure bare copper wire. This adherence to UL® Code 444 and National Electrical Code® TIA‑568‑C.2 fire and safety standards ensures maximum safety and reliability, as pure bare copper wire is mandated for communication cables.In conclusion, the Monoprice Cat6 Patch Cable stands out as a top‑tier Ethernet cable, offering exceptional performance, durability, and safety. Whether you're setting up a home network or managing a professional IT infrastructure, this cable is the perfect choice to ensure fast, reliable, and secure connectivity.
